title: Reject or not?

choices: Don't reject the null, because the interval is wide
Accept that the average drop is exactly 28.85
Reject the null at the 1% cut-off; the average drop is estimated at about 17 to 41 points
Reject the null at the 5% cut-off only
explanations: Width doesn't matter; what matters is whether 0 is inside.
The CI gives a range of plausible values, not one exact value.
A 99% CI corresponds to a 1% cut-off (and 0 would also be outside the narrower 95% CI).

hints: The CI also tells you the size of the effect.
solution: 0 is outside the 99% CI, so reject the null at the 1% cut-off. The interval also estimates the average drop: 17.1 to 40.6.
